Required stock level = (1 / (1 - p90)) \* 30 \* Avg daily demand

Required stock level = (1 / (1 - 0.9)) \* 30 \* 40.8 units/day
= 3.6 \* 30 \* 40.8 units
= 4327.2 units

Since we already have 1086 units in stock, we need to order an additional:

4327.2 units (required) - 1086 units (in stock) = 3241.2 units

Therefore, to ensure that the stock covers the 90%-service-level (p90) 30-day demand, we must order approximately 3241 units of PART_011.
